outcome: mother and newborn skin-to-skin contact (SSC) practice
cohort: The study included 5304 women from Bangladesh who gave birth in the last 3 years preceding the 2017-18 Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey.
finding: The prevalence of skin-to-skin contact (SSC) practice in Bangladesh was 15.6%, and it was significantly associated with geographic region, place of delivery, mode of delivery, and number of antenatal care visits.
mod_finding: Women who had a normal delivery had 2.1 times higher odds of practicing skin-to-skin contact compared to those who delivered by cesarean section.
